title: Learning Commute-Time-Preserving World Models for Planning
abstract: arXiv:2610.01373v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: World models allow agents to plan in latent space by choosing a sequence of actions that most reduces the distance to a given goal state. Thus, planning can benefit from latent representations whose distances mirror commute-times in the environment. The spectral embedding space of the graph Laplacian provides such a representation, if it obeys a specific eigenvalue-dependent scaling. Unfortunately, instantiating the graph Laplacian is intractable in large, continuous environments. Self-supervised learning offers a natural route to such commute-time-preserving embeddings at scale. However, here we show that existing methods, which commonly encourage isotropic representations to prevent representational collapse, tend to degrade the "correct" eigenvalue-dependent scaling, leading to an inaccurate representation of commute times. translated_title: 面向规划的保持通勤时间世界模型学习
translated_abstract: 世界模型使智能体能够在潜空间中进行规划，即选择最能缩短与给定目标状态之间距离的动作序列。因此，规划可以从这样的潜空间表示中受益——其距离能够反映环境中的通勤时间。图拉普拉斯算子的谱嵌入空间正好提供了这样一种表示，前提是它遵循一种特定的与特征值相关的缩放。遗憾的是，在大型连续环境中实例化图拉普拉斯算子是难以实现的。自监督学习为大规模获得这种保持通勤时间的嵌入提供了一条自然的途径。然而，本文表明，现有方法通常通过鼓励各向同性的表示来防止表示坍塌，这往往会破坏这种“正确的”与特征值相关的缩放，从而导致对通勤时间的不准确表示。为解决这一问题，我们提出了保持通勤时间的世界模型（CTWMs），它将潜在位移（latent displacement）……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文发现现有自监督学习方法为防止表示坍塌而采用的各向同性正则化会破坏通勤时间保持所必需的特征值相关缩放，进而提出保持通勤时间的世界模型（CTWM），使智能体能够更准确地在潜空间中进行规划。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that isotropic regularization in existing self-supervised methods distorts the eigenvalue-dependent scaling needed to preserve commute times, and introduces Commute-Time-Preserving World Models (CTWMs) to enable more accurate latent-space planning.
